input.reason: The repository has no tests at all. The working tree holds only package.json and src/*.ts files: routes, jira, worktree, crypto, git-auth, api, dashboard, ci, config, tasks and store. No file name contains "test" or "spec". A search of src and package.json for encrypt, decrypt, test and spec found no test code. The only matches were the definitions in src/crypto.ts:3 and :10 and the `"test": "node --test"` script in package.json, and that script has no test files to run. So nothing checks that encrypt/decrypt round-trip correctly or that decrypt rejects tampered input through the GCM auth tag (setAuthTag/final at src/crypto.ts:13-14).
